description: On CI the unit suite's time is dominated by git subprocess spawns (about 25 ms per spawn on macos-latest, 5 ms on ubuntu-latest). The ten existing calibration test files in scope take roughly 176.8 s summed on macOS and 30+ s on ubuntu over nearly 200 cases on main and start over 7,500 git processes; tests/test_calibrate_rerun.py alone is one of the slowest unit files on macOS (55.5 s, 2,404 git processes, 98 percent inside the test call). Per-test coverage shows identical line sets for test_calibrate_sync.py's three tests of one scenario, test_calibrate_rebuild.py's two stale-branch tests, and test_calibration_self_check.py's two run_calibrate tests.
goal: Cut git subprocess spawns across the files in scope by at least 30 percent with measurable wall-clock time reduction without weakening what they prove: run shared calibration scenarios once per module over private copies while keeping every assertion; collapse identical-coverage cases only where the parameter is data the code does not branch on. Test code only: never modify files under apps/sandbox-executor/src or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, keep every touched module within its line budget, and place any shared helper code in a new module (such as apps/sandbox-executor/tests/calibrate_scenarios.py) rather than growing an existing file past its limit. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Reducing repeated git subprocess spawns across the ten calibration test files measurably cuts unit test runtime on both macOS and ubuntu CI runners and workspace survival runs with zero production code risk.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes carry a before and after table per file in scope (test_calibrate_rerun.py, test_calibrate_rebuild.py, test_calibrate_staleness.py, test_calibrate_sync.py, test_calibrate_full_stage5.py, test_calibration_commit.py, test_calibration_self_check.py, flow/test_calibrate_nested_refs.py, test_calibrate_no_fallback.py, test_calibration_evaluated_sha.py, and optional helper calibrate_scenarios.py) showing summed test time, case count, and git process count from 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress" --durations=0 --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine, median of at least three alternating runs; git subprocess spawns across the files in scope fall by at least 30 percent with measurable wall-clock time reduction.

Every removed or merged test is listed with the surviving test that proves the same behaviour and the evidence (identical or subset line coverage from a per-test coverage context run, plus the assertion it carried now made by the surviving test). No test that guards a distinct behaviour is removed: a test named for a regression, an incident or an edge case is kept or its assertion is folded into a surviving test, never dropped.
Line and branch coverage do not fall, and the mutation score of touched modules does not fall.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed.
The module budget file is not changed, and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"', the files in scope also pass serially with '-p no:xdist' (no order dependence from shared fixtures), and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
